entity.summary: Rotterdam-based European crypto broker / exchange platform founded in 2013. LiteBit announced on 2023-05-23 that it intended to cease operations because of market developments, increased competition, and regulatory pressure. The Dutch ACM approved Bitvavo's acquisition of LiteBit's business on 2023-06-06, including the customer-base transition; LiteBit's current official site confirms operations have ceased and eligible customer funds were moved to Bitvavo.
entity.notes: HEI models LiteBit as acquired because the Dutch ACM approved Bitvavo B.V.'s acquisition of the LiteBit business and LiteBit's customer transition was implemented toward Bitvavo. The prior exact death_date 2023-08-14 is removed because the recovered first-party/regulatory sources confirm cessation and acquisition but do not establish that exact terminal day.

events.title: LiteBit announced plans to cease operations
events.description: LiteBit announced that it intended to terminate its activities because of market developments, increased competition, and mounting regulatory pressure, while offering customers a path to move assets to Bitvavo subject to regulatory approval.
events.notes: The announcement is distinct from the later ACM acquisition approval and does not by itself establish the exact final shutdown date.

events.title: ACM approved Bitvavo acquisition of LiteBit
events.description: The Dutch Authority for Consumers & Markets approved Bitvavo B.V.'s acquisition of the LiteBit business. Bitvavo subsequently communicated the customer-base migration process and LiteBit's current site confirms eligible customer funds were transferred to Bitvavo.
events.notes: This supports the acquired classification and Bitvavo successor relationship. It does not supply a separate exact service-termination day, so death_date is left null.

evidence.title: Bitvavo welcomes new clients from crypto broker LiteBit
evidence.notes: First-party counterparty announcement reproduces LiteBit's same-day decision to end activities and includes a statement from LiteBit COO Arthur van Lier.

evidence.title: Bitvavo mag de onderneming van LiteBit overnemen
evidence.notes: ACM states that Bitvavo B.V. may acquire the LiteBit business and that the authority decided this on 2023-06-06.

evidence.title: LiteBit no longer available
evidence.notes: LiteBit's current official site states that operations have ceased and explains that eligible customer funds were moved to Bitvavo.

expected.summary: Rotterdam-based European crypto broker / exchange platform founded in 2013. LiteBit announced in May 2023 that it would cease operations because of market developments, increased competition, and regulatory pressure; Bitvavo subsequently received ACM approval to acquire LiteBit's customer base and migrate user assets and accounts.
expected.notes: HEI models LiteBit as acquired because Bitvavo acquired the LiteBit customer base after LiteBit decided to cease operations. This should not be read as a full corporate acquisition of every LiteBit asset; the record is specifically about the exchange/broker service ending and the customer-base migration to Bitvavo.
